newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to pre-pay $590 mln to IMF - gov't.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to pre-pay $590 mln to IMF - gov't.

text.p: Mexico plans to pre-pay some $590 million in loans to the International Monetary Fund (IMF), the Finance Ministry said in a statement on Wednesday.

The ministry said Mexico would be receiving funds in the next days from two recent bond issues totalling $1.18 billion. It said half the money would be used to pre-pay the IMF and the other half would go to build international reserves.
The money will come from Mexico's two most recent bond issues on the international financial markets.

Part of the money, some $300 million from a bond issue in lire, will arrive in Mexico's coffers on February 20 and the rest, raised in a mark bond issue worth some $880 million, will arrive on February 24.
"In this way, we continue with the strategy of pre-paying our debt in order to diminish the concentration of payments due in 1998, 1999 and 2000," the ministry said.
